channel.title: QuotePlace — Quote of the Day
channel.description: One quote, every day, chosen deterministically from the QuotePlace collection.

item.title: Epictetus — Quote of the Day, 2026-11-05
item.description: “Men are disturbed not by things, but by the views which they take of them.” — Epictetus

item.title: Henry Ford — Quote of the Day, 2026-11-04
item.description: “Obstacles are those frightful things you see when you take your eyes off your goal.” — Henry Ford

item.title: Confucius — Quote of the Day, 2026-11-03
item.description: “The superior man is satisfied and composed; the mean man is always full of distress.” — Confucius

item.title: Confucius — Quote of the Day, 2026-11-02
item.description: “To see what is right and not to do it is want of courage.” — Confucius

item.title: Marcus Aurelius — Quote of the Day, 2026-11-01
item.description: “You always own the option of having no opinion. There is never any need to get worked up about things you cannot control.” — Marcus Aurelius

item.title: Sylvia Plath — Quote of the Day, 2026-10-31
item.description: “I can never read all the books I want; I can never be all the people I want and live all the lives I want.” — Sylvia Plath

item.title: Doug Larson — Quote of the Day, 2026-10-30
item.description: “Wisdom is the reward you get for a lifetime of listening when you'd have preferred to talk.” — Doug Larson

item.title: Marcus Aurelius — Quote of the Day, 2026-10-29
item.description: “Dwell on the beauty of life.” — Marcus Aurelius
